description: This source file defines the 'XColor' struct, a core class for representing colors in the PDFsharp library. It supports multiple color spaces (RGB, CMYK, GrayScale), provides various constructors and factory methods for creating colors from different input formats, and includes properties for color manipulation and conversion. The file also contains methods for color comparisons, color property calculations (hue, saturation, brightness), and interoperability with other color types like System.Drawing.Color and WPF Color.

classes.name: XColor
classes.description: A struct representing colors in various color spaces (RGB, CMYK, Grayscale) for the PDFsharp library, with support for color creation, conversion, comparison, and property calculations.

methods.name: FromArgb
methods.description: Static factory method to create an XColor from ARGB components.

methods.name: FromCmyk
methods.description: Static factory method to create an XColor from CMYK components.

methods.name: FromGrayScale
methods.description: Static factory method to create an XColor from a grayscale value.

methods.name: FromKnownColor
methods.description: Static factory method to create an XColor from a predefined known color.

methods.name: GetHue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the hue component of the color in degrees.

methods.name: GetSaturation
methods.description: Calculates and returns the saturation component of the color.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Calculates and returns the brightness component of the color.
